premise: A fresh or recovering independently operated node remains able to reconstruct and validate canonical state as chain age and stored history grow, without trusting an official snapshot or silently crossing a fixed sync ceiling.
required_scenarios: fresh state with chain-distance 50001 or greater
interrupted initial synchronization followed by restart/resume
storage growth measurement across representative chain ages
validation continuity across any future pruning/archival boundary
current_evidence: Authoritative peer node validates headers before blocks and replays downloaded blocks.
Independent Node v1.1 has durable recovery/fail-closed recovery tests.
Authoritative peer sync currently bounds downloaded branch history at MAX_BRANCH_BLOCKS=50000.
acceptance: No hidden trust in an official state snapshot.
A scale ceiling must be explicit and evidence-bound; reaching it may not be reported as survivability PASS.
Any pruning/archival design must preserve enough evidence for trustless validation/recovery and requires separate review if it changes consensus-observable behavior.
Interrupted sync must resume or safely restart without accepting partially validated state.
